Sam (Org): Hey team — quick all-hands heads-up for next Tuesday 10:00am PT (60m). Agenda draft below, please drop any Qs or items you want included. will lock agenda EOD Friday. :calendar: 

Sam (Org): AGENDA (draft)
```
- 10m: Exec updates (roadmap + biz health)
- 20m: Product spotlight — Dedicated rollout metrics + demo
- 15m: Infra & reliability — recent incident summary + mitigations
- 10m: People Ops spot & hiring update
- 5m: Q&A and close
```

Sam (Org): If you have live demo needs (screens, creds, dataset), reply here so we can slot you. Also please add any Qs you want answered in the session — I'll surface them to speakers. @everyone feel free to react or DM me. :loud_sound:

Priya (Product): Can we add a 5m callout on the SLA changes for Dedicated customers? Need to announce new latency SLO and rollout plan.

Darren (Eng): +1 SLA callout. Also can I get 10m for a short demo of the new batching dashboard? It helps explain cost/latency tradeoffs.

Sam (Org): Good call. I'll shift product spotlight to include a 10m demo and 5m SLA detail. thanks.

Lena (EMEA): Heads-up — 10am PT is 6pm for London. Can we share recording link promptly after and a short summary with action items? A few EMEA folks will join asynchronously.

Sam (Org): Absolutely — we'll post recording + 3 bullet summary within 1 hour.

Carlos (Infra): I'll prepare a one-slide incident timeline for the infra segment. Also tagging @Darren for demo handoff.

Darren (Eng): Thanks @Carlos — i'll prep a short script and a sample trace to show batching impact.

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Company All-Hands — Ops & Product" on Tue 10:00am PT (Zoom link added). Attendees: everyone invited. Reminder set 15m prior.

Maya (People Ops): Adding a 5m People Ops segment; will highlight org changes, new hires, and a quick recognition shoutout. If you have kudos to share, drop them here or use the #recognize channel and I'll include a few. :star2: 

Priya (Product): submitting a Q: What are the criteria for projects to get Dedicated capacity vs. Hosted? Can you outline the cost implications briefly?

Sam (Org): Noted — Priya's Q will go to product + finance to answer live.

--- (meeting happens) ---

Sam (Org): POST: Thanks everyone who joined live or async. Recording: https://zoom.redwood.example/rec/abc123 (expires in 90 days). Quick takeaways below.

Sam (Org): TAKEAWAYS:
- Exec: pipeline healthy; focus on enterprise sales + Dedicated capacity growth.
- Product: Dedicated SLA rolling out next month; customers will see "p90 latency" guarantees on reserved pools.
- Demo: Batching dashboard reduced per-token cost ~18% on sample workload; follow-up doc: https://redwood.docs/internal/batching-dashboard
- Infra: recent outage root cause = GPU kernel OOM on low-entropy prompts; mitigation = probe-based throttling + new alert rule.
- People Ops: 12 new hires coming in Q3; recognition highlights posted separately.

Sam (Org): ACTIONS (owners):
- @Darren: upload demo artifacts + short how-to (due in 3 business days).
- @Carlos: finalize incident RCA and link to postmortem (due 2 business days).
- @Priya + Finance: publish SLA FAQ and pricing impact summary (due 5 business days).
- @Maya: post hires list + recognition thread (due EOD tomorrow).

Priya (Product): Will coordinate on the SLA FAQ with finance, sending first draft by EOD Fri.

Carlos (Infra): RCA draft will be in #postmortems and pinned to this thread when ready.

Lena (EMEA): Thanks for the recording + bullets — appreciated. i'll share with the EU leadership sync.

Maya (People Ops): Recognition thread: https://slack.redwood.example/archives/CKUD9/ply123 — drop shoutouts there.

Darren (Eng): Demo assets uploaded: https://s3.redwood.example/batching-demo.zip — includes script and trace.

Sam (Org): Closing — if you asked a question and didn't get it answered live, reply here and I'll follow up with the owners. Thanks all. :pray:
